What Is My Experience With MedBridge?

Hi, I’m Julia, a speech-language pathologist who specializes in adult neurogenic disorders, and I’ve been using MedBridge since 2016. I’ve had the pleasure of watching MedBridge grow and its catalog of CEUs and home exercise programs expand over 10 years. 

I use MedBridge almost daily to assign home exercise programs and patient education to my patients. I also listen to their podcasts for CEUs, earn live CEUs, and take pre-recorded CEUs through their subscription.

When I was a traveling therapist, MedBridge came in clutch to earn CEUs while I was on the road and had difficulty attending live courses. 

I partnered with MedBridge and am happy to share a discount code with you to save on your subscription. Whether you are a traveling therapist, or perm (like me now) you can use TRAVELTHERAPY to save.

What is MedBridge?

MedBridge is an online continuing education and patient engagement provider for Speech-Language Pathologists, Occupational Therapists, Athletic Trainers, Nurses, and Physical Therapists.

MedBridge is an amazing source of continuing education credits for all therapists. 

It is especially useful for traveling therapists who may find it difficult to attend live seminars while on assignment.

As a subscriber, you have access to hundreds of online CEU courses, podcast episodes, and live webinars.

The courses range from evaluation to treatment and from pediatrics to geriatrics. Courses also include topics related to compliance. 

You get to watch the classes that you want when you need them. They even have podcasts that you can listen to for CEU credit.

No need to wait until a trainer comes to town or spend tons of money to attend a conference. 

You can earn high-quality CEUs from the comfort of your living room or your car.

The classes are also on demand when you need them. Maybe you are getting a patient coming into your clinic and need to brush up on something specific, such as resonant voice therapy or the effects of radiation treatment on swallowing. There is a MedBridge class for that!

Who Is This Promo Good for?

The TRAVELTHERAPY MedBridge discount code can save $106 for Physical Therapists, Occupational Therapists, Speech-Language Pathologists, and Athletic Trainers.

Students of physical, occupational, and speech therapy can use the code: “TTStudent” to save. Read more here: MedBridge Student Discount.

How to Get a MedBridge Promo Code TRAVELTHERAPY Applied to Your Account:

  1. Go to MedBridge and click “save now.”
  2. Under “choose discipline,” select your respective discipline (PT, OT, SLP, etc.)
  3. Then, select between a premium or educational membership and click “choose plan.”
  4. Enter your information. Under promo code, make sure “TRAVELTHERAPY15” is selected. If not, you can edit it and enter it for the best deal.
  5. Create your MedBridge login, and you are ready to go

Will my Membership Renew at the Same Price?

No, it will not.

Using this MedBridge promo code locks in your discounted rate for one-year. If you choose to auto-renew your membership, you will renew at the standard subscription rate.

What is the Difference Between the Premium and Educational membership?

The main difference between the education and premium memberships is that the premium membership includes patient education and a home exercise program tool. 

Both memberships come with unlimited access to the MedBridge CEU library. 

Patient education in the premium membership includes videos and handouts. You can print or send the handouts/videos to your patients digitally. 

Additionally, with the premium membership, you can have your patients set up a program to view home exercises and educational handouts you select for them.

The home exercise program (HEP) builder contains a library of over 5,000 exercises (for PT, OT, and SLP)! Providers are able to text or email the HEP programs directly to their patients, or they may also be printed.

Does MedBridge offer Live Courses?

Yes, MedBridge offers live webinars on its platform. This is especially helpful if you are licensed in states that require live courses and accept live webinars. The topics vary, and they tend to do one live a month. I’ve used the live webinars to help maintain my California SLP license. 

They do not offer live, in-person courses. 

What is the MedBridge Coupon Code for SLPs?

SLPs, you can use the MedBridge promo code “TRAVELTHERAPY” to save too. SLP memberships start at $299 per year.

How Can I Earn CEUs for Listening to Podcasts?

One of my favorite newer MedBridge features is that you can earn CEUs by listening to their podcasts.

As a fast listener and thinker, I love listening to podcasts in my car while driving to work and setting the speed to 1.2x to listen a little faster – it’s like medicine to my brain.

You can listen to podcast episodes on the MedBridge platform or on any podcast platform you use.

Once you complete the podcast, you log in to your MedBridge account, find the podcast you listened to in their library, and take a learning assessment.

After completing the learning assessment and course review, you get credit for the podcast episode just like you would for any other course.

MedBridge podcasts include:

  • Innovative Aging: Discussing ways to keep patients thriving independently at home
  • Rehab and Performance Lab: Exploring research and cases in the orthopedics and sports world
  • Speech Scope (my personal favorite): Talks about difficult medical SLP clinical topics and evidence to support solutions
  • Pediatric Pioneers: Breaks down tough topics pediatric occupational therapists face.
  • Neuro Navigators: Industry experts talk about neurologic and geriatric rehabilitation for PT and OT.
  • House Call: Protecting Our People: For home health professionals to discuss violence prevention and best practices for safety in home visits.

Does MedBridge Report CEUs Directly to ASHA?

Yes, they do! MedBridge reports completed continuing education credits to ASHA within 45 days after the end of the month in which the course was completed. Once reported, it could take an additional 2-3 weeks to appear in your CE registry. 

While it might take a while for them to show up on your registry, they do get reported. And you receive copies of your completed certificates in your account, which you can access at any time.

I’ve spoken to many SLPs who are concerned because they took a MedBridge course, and they didn’t see it on their CE registry. Give it time, they report, and it will be there.

Does MedBridge have a free trial?

MedBridge does not have a free trial. However, the website is fairly open, and you can see exactly which courses are available. You do not have to purchase without knowing whether the courses are ones you want to take. 

If you go to the MedBridge website, you can be completely signed out and still browse their CEU library. 

For example, here is a list of all of the SLP CE courses available. 

So is MedBridge Worth It?

Absolutely, YES! Continuing education courses do not need to be expensive or challenging to complete. In the digital world, we have so much information at our fingertips, and MedBridge is a great resource to provide education directly to you when you need it.

As a speech-language pathologist, I have found MedBridge invaluable. 

Especially when I was working travel speech therapy contracts, MedBridge came in clutch, helping me earn CEUs on the road.

I recommend MedBridge not only to all the travelers I know but also to all clinicians. I am excited to share it with you today and hope that you take advantage of this great offer.
